name: darktable
param_style: C sqlite3 API; mostly g_strdup_printf-built SQL with values inlined, ?N binds for point statements
schema_source: CREATE statements extracted from src/common/database.c (_create_library_schema, _create_data_schema, _create_memory_schema, upgrade steps to library v57 / data v13); data./memory. schema prefixes dropped, data.meta_data renamed data_meta_data
data_scale: scale 1: 400 film rolls, 100k images (~6% duplicates, ~30% geotagged), ~1.5k tags, ~386k tagged_images, ~260k history rows, ~24k colour labels, ~140k metadata rows, 40 map locations, ~9k collected images, ~250 selected
visibility_note: 13k stars; the main open-source raw developer, every install keeps its catalogue in SQLite (library.db + data.db)
interest_note: Lighttable collection query built from per-property WHERE fragments with a grouping subquery that repeats the whole WHERE, DISTINCT over derived tables, multi-key sorts; collect-module GROUP BY lists; tag-suggestion co-occurrence self-join; prefix-path OR joins over the tag hierarchy; geometric joins for map locations.
reach_note: main open-source raw developer, in every Linux distro
